Since the expansion plan involves adding 600 seats (from 3,500 to 4,100) [NL-025#NL-025-S06], this condition must be met before expansion proceeds.

The Q3 2026 action plan includes implementing SCIM user sync by August 15 and monitoring ingestion queue performance [NL-025#NL-025-S07], and the renewal plan already prepares an order form for 4,100 seats and WorkflowCoach addendum [NL-025#NL-025-S07]. Given that Beacon will not proceed with the broad rollout without SCIM operational [NL-025#NL-025-S05], the expansion must be conditioned on successful SCIM implementation and mitigation of the citation lag.
